## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Validation

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] Manual hardware checks, when applicable
- [ ] No credentials, biometrics, personal captures or local settings included

## Architecture and safety

- [ ] Modules remain decoupled through events
- [ ] Windows actions remain allowlisted
- [ ] New external inputs are validated
- [ ] Privacy or security behavior is documented

## Screenshots or logs

Attach only sanitized material with no faces, API keys or personal information.
